summary: Elden Ring franchise entries added as supplemental sourced guide rows; Sami did not list these in the locked personal spine.

entries.title: Elden Ring
entries.definitive_edition: Windows version with Shadow of the Erdtree

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC with current patch and Shadow of the Erdtree

primary.version: Elden Ring with Shadow of the Erdtree
primary.why: Elden Ring released on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S, with Shadow of the Erdtree released in 2024 as the major expansion. Windows is the best archive route because it has the highest capture/settings ceiling, covering the PC version and expansion route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version with Shadow of the Erdtree installed. Verify current patch and online/service state before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: The announced Nintendo Switch 2 Tarnished Edition should be evaluated only after it ships; it is not counted as a released platform row in this pass.

entries.title: Elden Ring Nightreign

primary.why: Nightreign is a standalone adventure within the Elden Ring universe, not a required ownership add-on. It released on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S, so Windows is the best archive route for fidelity, capture, and settings.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version through Steam. Because Nightreign is multiplayer/co-op focused, verify current online service state before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Standalone spin-off rather than Elden Ring DLC; verify live online state before capture.
